stem:
Which of the following statements is correct about the cell shown in figure?

(The figure is a labelled diagram of a neuron. P points to the star-shaped cell body (cyton) bearing dendrites, Q points to the long axon below it, R points to a constriction between two myelin segments of the axon, and S points to the branched axon terminals at the bottom.)

options.label: A
options.text: All of these

options.label: B
options.text: P receives nerve impulse from Q and conveys it to other cells.

options.label: C
options.text: R is called node of Ranvier.

options.label: D
options.text: P conducts impulse away from cyton while S conducts impulse towards cyton.

stem:
Pankaj was asked to draw a labelled diagram of sclerenchyma tissue as seen in longitudinal section. The figure he drew is shown here. Point out the mistake in the figure.

(The figure shows a group of polygonal, many-sided cells packed together — a transverse (cross) section — with the labels 'Lumen', 'Simple pit pore' and 'Lignified thick wall' pointing to the cells.)

options.label: A
options.text: The cell walls are not lignified in sclerenchyma.

options.label: B
options.text: The figure shows transverse section instead of longitudinal section of tissue.

options.label: C
options.text: Instead of simple pit pore, it should be bordered pit.

options.label: D
options.text: The nucleus and cytoplasm are not shown.

stem:
The tissue shown in the given figure is

(The figure shows long, narrow, elongated cells with tapering, overlapping pointed ends and thick walls enclosing a narrow lumen — a longitudinal view of fibres.)

options.label: A
options.text: Angular collenchyma, in which wall thickenings are present at the angles

options.label: B
options.text: Xylem vessel that forms long channels for conduction of water and minerals

options.label: C
options.text: Phloem parenchyma with abundant food reserve

options.label: D
options.text: Sclerenchyma, in which uniform wall thickenings are present

stem:
The tissue shown here is ______.

(The figure shows a cluster of large, rounded cells each with a big clear fat-filled interior and a small nucleus pushed to one side against the cell wall.)

options.label: A
options.text: Adipose tissue

options.label: B
options.text: Striated muscle tissue

options.label: C
options.text: Ciliated columnar epithelial tissue

options.label: D
options.text: Areolar tissue

stem:
Observe the given figures of three different plant tissues and select the correct statement.

(The figure shows three plant tissues in cross section. Figure a: thin-walled, closely packed rounded cells (parenchyma). Figure b: cells with very thick walls all around and a tiny lumen (sclerenchyma). Figure c: cells with extra wall thickenings concentrated at the corners/angles and a wide lumen (collenchyma).)

options.label: A
options.text: Cell walls of a, b and c bear uniform thickening of suberin.

options.label: B
options.text: a provides mechanical strength to the plant while b and c serve as storage tissues.

options.label: C
options.text: Cytoplasm is present in cells of a while it is absent in cells of b and c.

options.label: D
options.text: a and b consist of living cells while c consists of dead cells.
